title: Dragonfight Updated
description: This datapack is an improvement of the dragon fight. With a new mini-boss and even more.
body: This datapack is an improvement of the dragon fight. With a new mini-boss called Ender he is a bigger form of an Enderman which gives you levitation in an 20 block radius. An other improvement is that if you are in a 20 block radius of an end crystal you will shrink into half of your regular size and if you get then near an enderman you will grow into your normal size. There is also a new Elytra type called the Dragon Elytra which gives you 3 more blocks save fall distance. There are also two new advancements but i wont spoil anymore and I hobe you will have fun playing this.
